konu: Is one egg a day bad for your heart?
baslik_yt: One Egg a Day for 32 Years: What Happened to Heart Risk?
aciklama: Harvard researchers followed over 215,000 people for up to 32 years. Here is what one egg a day did to their heart risk, and where the evidence disagrees.
kaynaklar: Drouin-Chartier JP, et al. Egg consumption and risk of cardiovascular disease: three large prospective US cohort studies, systematic review, and updated meta-analysis. BMJ. 2020;368:m513. https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.m513
Zhong VW, et al. Associations of Dietary Cholesterol or Egg Consumption With Incident Cardiovascular Disease and Mortality. JAMA. 2019;321(11):1081-1095. https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2019.1572

sahneler.aksiyon: a boiled egg wobbles in a porcelain egg cup as steam curls up from it, while a tall stack of old calendar pages flips rapidly beside it in a breeze, morning light, no person
sahneler.anlatim: One egg a day, every day, for thirty-two years.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader quickly flips through thick old ledgers at a long desk covered with egg cartons, writing notes with a quill, candle flames flickering, pages turning
sahneler.anlatim: Harvard researchers followed over 215,000 people for up to 32 years to test it.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader cracks an egg into a small iron pan, the egg sizzles and the white spreads and turns opaque, steam rising, he smiles calmly, no other people anywhere
sahneler.anlatim: Eating up to one egg a day was not linked to higher heart disease risk.

sahneler.aksiyon: an egg cracks open on its own and the bright yolk slides slowly into a white porcelain dish, the brass apothecary balance beside it tips and gently settles, no person
sahneler.anlatim: A large yolk holds about 186 milligrams of cholesterol, but your liver makes most of yours.

sahneler.aksiyon: two old books lie open side by side and their pages flip by themselves, an egg rolls slowly across each book, a brass magnifying glass slides between them, no person
sahneler.anlatim: A 2019 JAMA study disagreed, linking each extra half egg daily to six percent more risk.

sahneler.aksiyon: two breakfast plates side by side, on the left bacon sizzles and butter melts on white toast beside a fried egg, on the right green vegetables steam beside an egg and whole grain bread, steam rising, no person
sahneler.anlatim: Often the real difference is what comes with the egg: bacon, butter and white toast.

sahneler.aksiyon: the Almanac reader cuts into a soft boiled egg so the yolk flows, then lifts whole grain toast and takes a bite, smiling by a sunny window, curtains moving, no other people anywhere
sahneler.anlatim: For most people, one egg a day fits; with high cholesterol, ask your doctor first.
